title: Roast my UI after a week prototyping
author: cxdxix-
selftext:
Tell me everything that is in your head, whether it’s good or bad ! 

I have been working on this for a week. I’m now focusing more on the gameplay and adding more ennemies and creatures to my world. 

Btw my game is a Creature-Collecting Extraction Action RPG !!!
